name: Athena
abilities: Pallas: Olympian Verdict Contest Oath of Intercept
passives: Aegis Favor: Pallas gains Favor when guardian play intercepts a declared threat and stores the impact as later utility on marble thunder line. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a divine contest law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of High Olympian courts.
lore: Athena, Aegis Strategist, is now canonized as one of the four playable god-Titans of Olympian. The Titan is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: wisdom-war goddess, aegis shield, owl sight, civic strategy and disciplined protection. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology god whose behavior expresses wisdom-war goddess, aegis shield, owl sight, civic strategy and disciplined protection; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Olympian canon.
visualDescription: Athena manifests as wisdom-war goddess, aegis shield, owl sight, civic strategy and disciplined protection from Olympian: beautiful intelligent feminine face, grey owl-bright eyes, serene mouth, straight noble nose; tall athletic feminine strategist frame, poised shoulders, clear waist-to-hip line, still tactical stance; signature silhouette: owl-crested helm, aegis scale cloak, spear vertical, shield geometry. Weapon: aegis shield and long bronze spear. Maintain the approved Titan Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Pallas — Aegis Spear Thrust Intercept
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Olympian source-culture damage at range 1; generate Momentum and a small Laurel Favor gain when used from trial-marked arena ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal halos, hoplite shield geometry.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Titan into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Laurel Trial Technique — Punishing Guard
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to intercepts lethal paths, counters oathbreakers/trespassers, and turns defense into threat. Builds Laurel Favor only when the player uses trial-marked arena ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Pallas: Olympian Verdict Contest Oath of Intercept
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Laurel Favor to impose a two-round rule from Celestial Heights of Olympus: intercepts lethal paths, counters oathbreakers/trespassers, and turns defense into threat. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Titan, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Nike Crowned Ascension
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Laurel Favor, transform nearby terrain into trial-marked arena ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Pallas Sentinel Aegis Laurel Spear
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through trial-marked arena ground. Visual: living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal halos, hoplite shield geometry.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Pallas Living Marble Bronze Cuirass
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Titan read as Celestial Heights of Olympus source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Pallas Oracle Ambrosia Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Laurel Favor and unlocks a mastery branch for Hermes Crossing Step, Athena Countermeasure, and Claim the Laurel. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: counter bosses and protect survival windows
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Pallas's Aegis Favor: a solo mechanic where Favor grows through marble thunder line, reaction-window mastery, and guardian decisions that intercept a declared threat and store the impact as later utility. Payoff: protect mission objects or civilians while still acting solo. Counterplay: multi-timing attacks and feints pull the guard out of position; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: multi-timing attacks and feints pull the guard out of position
